definitions: A character in J.R.R. Tolkien's 'The Lord of the Rings', a manipulative advisor to King Théoden of Rohan.
A person who offers insidious or deceptive counsel; a sycophantic and treacherous advisor.
examples: Gríma Wormtongue's influence over the king was detrimental.
He was accused of being a Wormtongue, whispering poison into the leader's ear.
